q1_issues.issue: The appositive "an Israeli obligation" is reduced to a bare (Obligated e) status atom, silently dropping "Israeli" — whose obligation it is — which the no-dropped-qualifier rule forbids.

"Mideast" is a capitalized proper noun premodifying "peace plan", so it must sit outside Compound concepts with its own Name atom; fusing it into mideast_peace_plan (also at statement 18's genus) treats a name as a compound modifier.

The modifier genus (Inheritance israeli_soldier israeli) is missing — israeli is an adjective predicable of the referent ("the soldier is Israeli"), and modifier-genus exposure is determined, not optional.

q2_gaps: a dash-attached NP appositive predicated of the whole preceding CLAUSE ("... tearing down outposts yesterday - an Israeli obligation under a new plan"): the appositive rule covers only an NP apposed to a referent, and there is no carrier for a deontic nominal's bearer since (Obligated e) is unary
notes: The inception shape (begin event Past + Ongoing tear_down as Theme), the deictic yesterday, LocatedIn for the stated "in the West Bank", and Under as a framing preposition-named oblique all match the instruction set. The tear_down event carries no Past, which follows the worked "began to applaud" example even though the prose says "both Past if past".
